<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אדר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917498_theRebbe_163" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_93_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917498_theRebbe_163__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Just as in sleep the faculties ascend to their source in the soul without deficiency, so too in exile the revelations ascend to their source in Israel, where they are complete, yet this is not manifest below, causing the exile, and when the sleep is disturbed, the revelation comes with a storm.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">However,</t>
    <t s="2">just as in the lower man the matter of unconsciousness during sleep is that the faculties ascend and depart to their source in the soul,</t>
    <t s="3">and the lack and deficiency in sleep is only in the revealed faculties</t>
    <t s="4">(that the faculties are in a disordered manner),</t>
    <t s="5">but not so the faculties included in the soul,</t>
    <t s="6">even though they are there in equality,</t>
    <t s="7">this is not a deficiency,</t>
    <t s="8">and on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="9">being included in the soul they are in perfection</t>
    <t s="10">(more than when they are drawn into revelation),</t>
    <t s="11">so too is it in the analogue,</t>
    <t s="12">that the matter of unconsciousness during the time of exile</t>
    <t s="13">(sleep)</t>
    <t s="14">is that the revelations ascend to their source,</t>
    <t s="15">and there,</t>
    <t s="16">the source of Israel,</t>
    <t s="17">with the virtue of Israel,</t>
    <t s="18">is with the entire storm</t>
    <t s="19">(similar to the faculties included in the soul,</t>
    <t s="20">which are in perfection),</t>
    <t s="21">except that this is above</t>
    <t s="22">(in the source),</t>
    <t s="23">and in the order of Hishtalshelus it is not discernible,</t>
    <t s="24">and therefore the matter of exile comes from this.</t>
    <t s="25">And when the sleep is disturbed and it is drawn from the source in inwardness</t>
    <t s="26">(in the order of Hishtalshelus)</t>
    <t s="27">then the virtue of Israel is revealed with a storm.</t>
    <t s="28">And based on this, the union of opposites in exile is even more emphasized,</t>
    <t s="29">that although during the time of exile the elevation of Israel is even greater than during the time of the Temple,</t>
    <t s="30">since in this time of exile the revelations ascend to their source, which is the source of Israel,</t>
    <t s="31">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="32">not only is the virtue of Israel not discernible below,</t>
    <t s="33">but they receive their influence through the ministers of the nations, being in exile among them.</t>
    <t s="34">And it can be said that this is one of the reasons that exile is compared to pregnancy,</t>
    <t s="35">for pregnancy in the mother's womb is a thing and its opposite.</t>
    <t s="36">For although a lamp is lit over his head etc. and they teach him the entire Torah etc.</t>
    <t s="37">(that this is specifically when he is in his mother's womb,</t>
    <t s="38">but not when he is born),</t>
    <t s="39">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="40">when he is in his mother's womb his head is between his knees,</t>
    <t s="41">so that the superiority of the head over the legs is not discernible,</t>
    <t s="42">and moreover,</t>
    <t s="43">his head is between his knees,</t>
    <t s="44">and even his food</t>
    <t s="45">(that he eats from what his mother eats)</t>
    <t s="46">is not through the mouth but through the navel,</t>
    <t s="47">as explained at length in the details of these matters in Torah Or by our master the Alter Rebbe</t>
    <t s="48">and in the discourses of our later Rebbes and Nesi'im.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>When the nations entered the Sanctuary they saw the cherubim embracing, indicating that at that moment there was a supremely high light above Hishtalshelus, and this is understood through the teaching that a man must visit his wife before a journey, for the exile is like pregnancy and the redemption like birth.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on this, it can be explained what our sages said,</t>
    <t s="2">"At the time when the nations entered the Sanctuary, they saw the cherubim embracing each other,"</t>
    <t s="3">for at first glance it is perplexing,</t>
    <t s="4">for cherubim embracing each other indicates the greatness of the love between the Holy One, blessed be He, and Israel, like the love of a man and a woman,</t>
    <t s="5">and at the time when the nations entered the Sanctuary, it was seemingly the opposite of love.</t>
    <t s="6">But the matter is,</t>
    <t s="7">that specifically then there was a most supreme light,</t>
    <t s="8">a light that is above Hishtalshelus,</t>
    <t s="9">and only that this light was in its place</t>
    <t s="10">(above Hishtalshelus)</t>
    <t s="11">and did not shine below</t>
    <t s="12">(in Hishtalshelus).</t>
    <t s="13">And one may add to this based on the teaching of our sages,</t>
    <t s="14">"A man is obligated to visit his wife at the time he goes on a journey,"</t>
    <t s="15">for since during the time of exile the Congregation of Israel is like a woman whose husband has gone overseas,</t>
    <t s="16">therefore,</t>
    <t s="17">before the departure of the husband</t>
    <t s="18">(the Holy One, blessed be He)</t>
    <t s="19">on the journey,</t>
    <t s="20">there was the visitation,</t>
    <t s="21">and therefore the cherubim were then like the embrace</t>
    <t s="22">of a man and his wife.</t>
    <t s="23">And based on this, it will be understood more deeply why exile is compared to pregnancy</t>
    <t s="24">(and redemption to birth),</t>
    <t s="25">for as below,</t>
    <t s="26">when a man visits his wife, the formation of the fetus occurs,</t>
    <t s="27">except that initially it is in pregnancy in his mother's womb</t>
    <t s="28">(in complete concealment,</t>
    <t s="29">and afterward in a manner of his head between his knees etc.),</t>
    <t s="30">and during the entire time of pregnancy it grows and develops until the time of birth arrives, when it emerges into the air of the world</t>
    <t s="31">(in revelation),</t>
    <t s="32">so too is it above,</t>
    <t s="33">that from the visitation that occurred in the moment before the exile, the drawing of the light immediately occurred</t>
    <t s="34">(the formation of the fetus)</t>
    <t s="35">also below,</t>
    <t s="36">except that its drawing is in concealment,</t>
    <t s="37">in a manner of exile</t>
    <t s="38">(pregnancy),</t>
    <t s="39">and during the time of exile it grows and develops from day to day until very soon there will be the birth and revelation in the future redemption.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>That the king's sleep was disturbed on that night occurred through Israel's self-sacrifice, which stems from the point of the soul above particular faculties, the level of Yechidah, causing the essential light above Hishtalshelus to shine in revelation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And the maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="2">that this, that on that night the sleep of the King, the King of the world, was disturbed</t>
    <t s="3">(the main miracle of Purim)</t>
    <t s="4">occurred through the self-sacrifice of Israel throughout the entire year.</t>
    <t s="5">And the matter is,</t>
    <t s="6">that the matter of self-sacrifice is from the point of the soul that is above particular faculties,</t>
    <t s="7">the level of Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="8">That is, the matter of self-sacrifice</t>
    <t s="9">(that it does not take into account calculations of intellect and other faculties)</t>
    <t s="10">is that it elevates his faculties to their source in the soul,</t>
    <t s="11">similar to the elevation of the faculties to their source during sleep.</t>
    <t s="12">Except that in sleep,</t>
    <t s="13">the elevation of the faculties to the soul is in a manner that the faculties depart from the limbs of the body and ascend to the soul as it is in concealment</t>
    <t s="14">(in its essence),</t>
    <t s="15">but not so in self-sacrifice,</t>
    <t s="16">for on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="17">the concealment of the soul is in arousal and in revelation,</t>
    <t s="18">and this affects the faculties as they are located in their place in the limbs of the body, that they become nullified to the soul</t>
    <t s="19">(so that it does not take them into account,</t>
    <t s="20">as above).</t>
    <t s="21">And this is what, through self-sacrifice, the sleep of the King, the King of the world, was disturbed,</t>
    <t s="22">for through the point of the soul</t>
    <t s="23">(which is above the Hishtalshelus in man)</t>
    <t s="24">shining in revelation,</t>
    <t s="25">through this it occurred also above,</t>
    <t s="26">that the essential light that is above Hishtalshelus</t>
    <t s="27">(to which the levels of Hishtalshelus ascend during sleep and exile)</t>
    <t s="28">shone in revelation.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
